page_title: DOR 2-3 HOF | Dortmund v Hoffenheim 25/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marco Fritz blows his whistle for a foul.
90+6' The resulting corner from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90+4' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
90+4' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim).
90+3' Emre Can (Dortmund) beats his marker in the air and aims a header at goal from the free kick, but the close-range effort flashes just over the bar.
90+3' Today's referee Marco Fritz rightly decides to book John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim) for his harsh tackle.
90+2' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Marco Fritz blows for a foul.
90+1' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Marco Reus as he is replaced by Julien Duranville (Dortmund).
85' Marco Reus (Dortmund) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
85' Dortmund take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
85' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
83' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Dortmund! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Marco Fritz and both teams have no complaints.
83' There's a break in play and referee Marco Fritz must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Dortmund using VAR. This could be interesting!
82' Surely that's handball by one of the Hoffenheim players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
82' A cross into the box from Donyell Malen (Dortmund) is cleared.
81' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
79' It is time for a substitution. Mats Hummels (Dortmund) is on for Julian Ryerson.
79' Here is a change. Umut Tohumcu is going off and Pellegrino Matarazzo gives the last tactical orders to Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ihlas Bebou trots off the pitch and is replaced by Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim).
79' Substitution. Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) on for Maximilian Beier.

77' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
75' Edin Terzic prepares a substitution. Ian Maatsen is replaced by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund).
75' It will be a substitution. Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) is ready to enter the pitch as Jadon Sancho walks off.
75' Edin Terzic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) replacing Niclas Fullkrug.
75' Golden chance! Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
73' A corner kick by Hoffenheim is thwarted by the well prepared Alexander Meyer (Dortmund).

72' Marco Reus (Dortmund) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Oliver Baumann guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
69' The corner is swung in but Dortmund can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
68' Andrej Kramaric comes off the pitch to be replaced by Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim).

64' 2 - 3 Anton Stach produces a sweet pass and picks out Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 2:3!
63' Marco Fritz blows his whistle after Donyell Malen (Dortmund) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
61' 2 - 2 Goal! Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) collected a pass and decided to try his luck from distance. The shot was deflected and it was enough to turn the ball past helpless Alexander Meyer. 2:2.
56' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) receives a precise pass outside the penalty area and strikes the ball goalwards. His attempt only finds one of his teammates, though, and ricochets away off him.
56' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) swings in a cross from the corner, but Oliver Baumann reads it well and gathers the ball.
54' A pass from Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) is intercepted by Alexander Meyer and the move breaks down.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hoffenheim comes to nothing.
51' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) is able to continue to play.
50' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) picks up an injury.
49' Pellegrino Matarazzo is forced to make a change. Robert Skov is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by David Jurasek (Hoffenheim).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) sees a yellow card from Marco Fritz after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
45' A quickly taken corner by Dortmund.
44' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
43' Marco Fritz blows for a foul after Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
39' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
37' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ian Maatsen (Dortmund).
35' The Hoffenheim players are exchanging some short passes.
31' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

28' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Alexander Meyer. This effort really didn't trouble him.

25' 2 - 1 GOAL! Marco Reus curls the free kick into the box. Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) peels off his marker and arrows a brilliant header past Oliver Baumann and into the right side of the net. 2:1.
24' Marco Reus (Dortmund) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
24' Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Marco Fritz didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
24' Marco Fritz blows his whistle for a foul after Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) hacks down one of his opponents. Dortmund are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
21' 1 - 1 GOAL - 1:1! The corner comes over and Marco Reus flicks on with his head to Donyell Malen (Dortmund), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
21' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) prepares to take a corner kick.

21' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee blows his whistle, Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
20' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner but it's cleared.

20' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Oliver Baumann guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. Dortmund force their opponents to concede a corner.

18' Ambitious effort from Ian Maatsen (Dortmund). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
15' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
13' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.

10' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Oliver Baumann makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
7' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
7' A dangerous looking corner kick from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is cleared to safety by the defence.

7' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the right-hand post. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Oliver Baumann with a fabulous save. The referee signals a corner kick to Dortmund.
6' There's an opportunity for Julian Brandt (Dortmund) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

6' Marco Reus (Dortmund) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman points to the corner flag, Dortmund are going to take it.
5' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
2' 0 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:1.
1' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Robert Skov (Hoffenheim), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
1' The first half has started.
Hoffenheim will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Marco Fritz.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
